source.title: The physiological basis and clinical significance of lung volume measurements.

whyItFits: Open review of static lung volumes and how they are interpreted, including why spirometry cannot measure residual volume, FRC, or total lung capacity.
limitations: Primary text is the open 2017 review of static lung volumes (CC BY). The 2019 ATS/ERS spirometry standard remains at source-spirometry.txt and covers manoeuvre quality, not static volumes. The 2023 lung-volume technical standard was not required once this interpretive review was available.
